name: Logflare MCP
tagline: Query Supabase logs and analytics from chat.
shortDescription: The Logflare MCP server. Query logs from your Supabase project, set up alerts, and inspect analytics. The simplest way to debug Supabase apps.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Logflare MCP server. Exposes the Logflare API (now part of Supabase) as MCP tools: query logs, list datasets, set up alerts, and inspect query performance.

## Why we recommend it

If you use Supabase, Logflare is where your logs go. The MCP server lets your agent search those logs, find slow queries, and debug errors — without leaving the chat.

## When to use it

- Debugging: agent finds errors in your Supabase logs
- Slow queries: agent identifies slow Postgres queries
- Alerts: agent sets up monitors for new error patterns
- Analytics: agent pulls usage stats for your Supabase project
installInstructions:
1. Get a Logflare API key from your Supabase dashboard (Logs → API)
2. Set `LOGFLARE_API_KEY=...` and `LOGFLARE_SOURCE_ID=...`
3. `npx -y @logflare/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Logflare/Supabase logs: included in Supabase free tier.
